I.effect_boundary: Offline fixtures and previews; live tests belong to assigned acceptance jobs.

F: Attempt to claim unobserved live success

X.timestamp_precision: date; midnight is a date marker, not execution time
X.objective: Turn an English or Japanese instruction into a resolved Japanese call request using existing voice and contact components.
steps: Audit existing contact-resolution and voice routing owners before adding a narrow preparation entry point.
Resolve an exact enabled contact; produce sender_name_ja and message_ja without adding promises or changing intent. Preserve the existing validated request format.
Reuse current microphone/STT adapters. Surface ambiguous names, negation, uncertain transcription and missing message details for targeted clarification.
Keep preparation preview separate from execution and carry one stable request ID from the bound instruction through submission.
Add behavioral tests for Japanese names, duplicate names, English-to-Japanese intent preservation, negation, missing fields and uncertain transcription.
acceptance: A concrete instruction produces the intended validated request and readable preview.
Ambiguous or negated instructions never reach the call adapter.
Existing prepared-request CLI and duplicate protections remain compatible.
X.rollback: Revert only owned changes; preserve journal and evidence. Reconcile any external effects; never automatically redial.
